findings.title: Benchmark realm capabilities drifted behind the authoritative server contract
findings.reproduction: Run the quick map benchmark before this audit branch; startup rejects skill-point capability parity.
findings.evidence: The fixture previously hand-authored getRealmInfo and omitted the live skillPointSystemVersion capability.
findings.recommendation: Keep release identity, contract hashes, realm capabilities, and progression versions derived from authoritative configuration.

findings.title: Missing optional pickup query silently switched ordinary benchmarks to the default region
findings.reproduction: Launch a benchmark without pickupSoakRegion and compare the active region with the scenario's primary region.
findings.evidence: normalizeRegionId(null) selected the default map; the runtime now distinguishes a missing parameter from an explicit region.
findings.recommendation: Retain the missing-query regression assertion in validate-map-benchmark.

findings.title: Always-on global chat raises base authenticated gameplay from 17 to 18 listeners
findings.affectedEnvironment: Canonical web and compatible itch.io client
findings.reproduction: Start an authenticated-equivalent session without opening a social panel and inspect active logical subscriptions.
findings.evidence: Every successful isolated browser case settles at 18 listeners: the established 17 gameplay streams plus chat.global. Region switches and recovery do not duplicate it.
findings.recommendation: Decide whether global chat must remain always-on; otherwise make it view-scoped on a separate synchronized branch and restore the exact 17-listener base budget.

findings.title: Stopped heartbeat lifecycles could apply late responses
findings.reproduction: Start a heartbeat, stop and restart the membership watcher before its response settles, then resolve the older request after the replacement begins.
findings.evidence: The focused regression reproduced a stale membership application and an older finalizer clearing the replacement request lock. The 15-second timeout and lifecycle generation guard now ignore stopped attempts while preserving the current lock.
findings.recommendation: Retain the timeout and lifecycle-generation regression coverage and verify interrupted-connection recovery during controlled release QA.

findings.title: Authenticated production login and second-tab recovery are not verified by repository tests
findings.reproduction: Use the approved pre-seeded QA account for cold login, warm login, refresh, second-tab replacement, interrupted connection, and logout.
findings.evidence: No QA account identity or authorization was supplied to this audit run, so no authenticated production writes were attempted.
findings.recommendation: Complete the controlled smoke test before treating production login as verified.

findings.title: Physical device and itch.io authenticated behavior still require release QA
findings.affectedEnvironment: Physical mobile devices and published itch.io artifact
findings.reproduction: Run the documented browser/device matrix and inspect the exact published itch.io build.
findings.evidence: This audit uses desktop Chromium emulation and repository artifact checks; it does not control a published itch.io authenticated session.
findings.recommendation: Verify relative assets, login entry, cache behavior, and backend compatibility in the published package.
